prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, highly detailed photograph of a video game controller completely covered in colorful, vibrant Froot Loops cereal pieces. The controller is the central subject, filling most of the frame, with its familiar buttons and joysticks partially visible beneath the playful, textured layer of cereal. The Froot Loops are arranged in a dense, almost mosaic-like pattern, their bright reds, blues, greens, yellows, and oranges creating a cheerful, eye-catching palette. A few cereal pieces are scattered on the pristine white surface beneath the controller, adding a sense of realism and casual playfulness. The lighting is soft and even, casting gentle shadows that emphasize the three-dimensional texture of the cereal. The background is minimal and out of focus, ensuring all attention remains on the whimsical, surreal fusion of gaming and breakfast. The overall style is crisp and hyperreal, with a touch of humor and pop-art sensibility, as if shot for a high-end commercial or editorial spread.
